result.reason: The operative language gives Customer ownership and includes a present assignment, while preserving Vendor Technology, but it does not grant Customer the required perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables and says nothing about Customer Data. Ownership is also improperly conditioned on payment. The margin comment cannot cure these omissions, and the referenced fallback licence is not included in the clause. The edits remain focused and generally preserve unrelated commercial intent, but “Vendor Technology” and the scope of the licence-back should be defined more clearly.
